method: Pinned fully expanded ESDB exports at sizes 60 and 70, identical classification/exact-exclusion policies and Relay additions. Static case-insensitive required-spelling coverage; shard integrity; real ordinary-link bottle path; five local HTTP/render reads per supplied prefix link. Timings include server rendering and loopback transfer, exclude WAN and participant reasoning, and have no causal before/after latency claim.
reason: Broader technical vocabulary while retaining frequency-first ordering; size 60 misses tokenizer/tokeniser families in this coverage set.
